PetDog.name: Subterrier
PetDog.description: A loyal canine companion who helps in fights and keeps you company. A very good pal.

PetCat.name: Embertail
PetCat.description: Spontaneous and impulsive in nature, this pet is as fierce in battle as they are at clawing at furniture. But also incredibly cuddly.

PetBird.name: Owlux
PetBird.description: A swift, beaked ally who will always love to fly around you. While too shy to partake in battle, they still have your back!

PetSlimeBlob.name: Jr. Orange Slime
PetSlimeBlob.description: An oozy little friend who is ready for adventures underground.

PetBunny.name: Fanhare
PetBunny.description: This feather-eared rodent is an able companion, making up for their size by swinging poisonous, sturdy hair into the enemy.

PetSlipperySlimeBlob.name: Jr. Blue Slime
PetSlipperySlimeBlob.description: A slippery little friend who is ready for adventures underground.

PetPoisonSlimeBlob.name: Jr. Purple Slime
PetPoisonSlimeBlob.description: A poisonous little friend who is ready for adventures underground.

PetLavaSlimeBlob.name: Jr. Lava Slime
PetLavaSlimeBlob.description: A scorching little friend who is ready for adventures underground.

PetPrinceSlimeBlob.name: Prince Slime
PetPrinceSlimeBlob.description: A royal little friend who is ready for adventures underground.

PetMoth.name: Pheromoth
PetMoth.description: A friendly companion from the moldy habitat. Their silky wings are not fit for battle but they will support you from a safe distance.

PetTardigrade.name: Snugglygrade
PetTardigrade.description: A cuddly, calm, and oddly brave companion. Watch it curl up and wiggle, but know that this new friend will not be afraid to join you in combat!

PetMagic.name: Arcane Symbiote
PetMagic.description: This strange creature feeds off arcane energies. While lacking physical influence, their ethereal power is felt by their host.

PetElectric.name: Electro-Pet
PetElectric.description: A tamed Electro-Pest. This spiky, otherworldly loaf of a predator is supplemented with electric coils. Their blue visor indicates friendliness to their owner.

PetWarlock.name: Earie
PetWarlock.description: A big-eared companion that begs you to not confuse their ears with their wings! While too timid for aggression, their glowing eyes instill ensurance in allies and strike fear in foes.

Cow.name: Moolin
Cow.description: Home to the meadows, this violet bovine is living its life away from danger, happily grazing all day and producing some of the finest milk.

Goat.name: Bambuck
Goat.description: The fuzzy Bambuck has more wool than patience, which is why it's quite bold by nature. It doesn't even see that much, so if it runs into you by accident be easy on it.

RolyPoly.name: Strolly Poly
RolyPoly.description: Content with everything going on around it, this gentle giant waddles through the darkness, always in search of a skittering, crunchy snack. Did you know that it is not even an insect?

CowBaby.name: Moolin Calf
CowBaby.description: The innocent juvenile of a Moolin, who has just learned how to stand on its own hoofs. It grows up faster than you think, so give it all the love you have.

GoatBaby.name: Bambuck Kid
GoatBaby.description: Not (yet) as stubborn as its parents, this kid is mostly concerned with charging at butterflies while its oversized ears flop around in the breeze. Truly a heartwarming sight to behold.

RolyPolyBaby.name: Strolly Poly Nymph
RolyPolyBaby.description: The young version of a Strolly Poly. Unlike its grown up parents, this one is in constant danger of being stepped on or being mistaken for a larva by careless explorers.

Turtle.name: Kelple
Turtle.description: A marine reptile and natural gardener, that chews down on kelp when it grows too plenty. It doesn't need many nutrients, so whatever it eats comes out again in a condensed ball shape that is free for the taking.

TurtleBaby.name: Kelple Hatchling
TurtleBaby.description: A young that comes up from the ground once it had enough time to slumber in the dark. Its shell is still blank but in time it will be populated by the kelp that it feeds on.

Dodo.name: Dodo
Dodo.description: Long believed to be extinct this species is still thriving in the underground: the dodo! If only Darwin could have seen this...

DodoBaby.name: Dodo Chick
DodoBaby.description: A cute chick full of determination to one day become a graceful dodo. It struggles with the size of its beak.

Camel.name: Drohmble
Camel.description: Evolved to survive the harsh desert climate, it produces a potent chemical base.

CamelBaby.name: Drohmble Calf
CamelBaby.description: A young Drohmble, eager to explore the desert.

GiantCicadaBoss.name: Nimruza, Queen of the Burrowed Sands

AFPestElectric.name: Electro-Pest
AFPestElectric.description: IS-0173-B is a cybernetically augmented Pest (IS-0173), a spiky, loaf-shaped juvenile creature. It lunges to pierce prey with its jaws, quills, and its now inadvertent electricity.
